skill_card.name: Test Data Generator
skill_card.description: Generates deterministic positive, negative, boundary, and API fixture payloads from test cases, validation rules, and schema constraints with seed-based reproducibility.

tasks.name: Evaluate schema constraints and validation rules
tasks.description: Parses field constraints, regex patterns, formats, and JSON Schema composition keywords into test data generators.
tasks.input_schema: Validation rules, API contracts, or schema definitions.

tasks.name: Synthesize deterministic fixture datasets
tasks.description: Generates positive, negative, boundary, and API request/response payloads with deterministic seeding.
tasks.output_schema: Structured fixture collections conforming to template schemas.

tasks.name: Map traceability and generate gap report
tasks.description: Attaches requirement/validation links to each fixture and records unresolvable references or skipped constraints.
tasks.output_schema: Traceability links and fixture gaps report.
